messages:
clare: Morning all (quick lane) we need a compact rollout plan for partner GPU bundle: H100 partner image, H200 fallback, MI300 pilot, Gaudi SI integration. Outcome: clear owners, legal/compliance gating, and an embargo window for joint comms.

dan: I'll take the H100 lane. Current issue: partner's image fails our runtime smoke when continuous streaming >800 tokens (observed stalls). Need vendor debug or we ship with throttling warning.

yasmin: MI300 update: model artifacts delivered but IP attestation missing. Legal will only allow SI-limited pilot until attestation is signed. Also note: MI300 quantized variant still needs an eval run for hallucination checks.

otto: Gaudi SI handoff status: SI asked for NFS mount docs and GPU-driver pinned manifest. Network team flagged that SI VPN certs expire next week. I'll renew certs but need 48h notice to schedule maintenance. Also H200 capacity confirmed for fallback.

clare: Action owners: Dan = H100 debug & fallback note; Yasmin = MI300 attestation + eval; Otto = Gaudi runbook + VPN cert renew. Compliance-bot please confirm required attestation form id and embargo wording.

compliance-bot: Required attestation: `ATT-03-CPU/GPU-IP` for model assets; SI-addendum template: `SI-ADD-1.2`. Embargo recommended wording: "Joint marketplace listing subject to final QA and partner sign-off. Do not publish before confirmed notification."

dan: Quick repro snippet I posted to the bug:
```
# repro streaming stall
./stream_test --model partner/h100:release-2024-09 --tokens 1200 --batch 1 --repeat 3 > stall.log
# attach stall.log to PART-1222
```

yasmin: Legal ETA: partner returns signed `ATT-03` by 2024-09-10 if no redlines. SI-limited pilot could start 2024-09-12. Marketing wants a 7-day embargo notice before SI pilot.

otto: VPN cert renew planned for 2024-09-08 02:00-03:00 PT. I'll post the maintenance window to infra. If partner needs earlier handoff, tell me now.

clare: Fallback decisions: If H100 stall persists beyond 72h, we list H200/B200 with a partner note and schedule H100 as a follow-up patch release. Yasmin, please confirm whether MI300 pilot dependency blocks GA for others.

yasmin: MI300 attestation is independent. We can GA H100/H200 without MI300, but marketing will want consistent messaging. Recommend SI-only MI300 pilot then GA later.

dan: I'll ping vendor tony@partner to escalate and request a signed kernel artifact or a patch. If no response in 24h, we enable the "reduced-streaming" knob in the image and proceed with warning.

clare: Tentative timeline: cosign & notarize image by 2024-09-09; VPN cert renew 9/08; ATT-03 signed by 9/10; SI pilot starts 9/12; marketplace SI-only list 9/15; GA window 9/29 pending QA. Flag blockers early.

compliance-bot: Reminder: cosign verification required for any partner image. Use `cosign verify` and attach verification output to PART-1222.

otto: Noted. Scheduling a dry-run mount test Thu 09/07 for SI NFS mounts. Will post results here.

yasmin: I'll coordinate legal & post when ATT-03 is signed. Marketing contact is @maria-marketing; will loop her once attestation is in.

dan: Update: raised PART-1222 to vendor and attached stall logs. If needed I can cut a safe image by EOD tomorrow.

clare: Excellent. Owners recapped: dan=image & fallback; yasmin=legal attestation & MI300 eval; otto=si runbook & vpn cert; clare=announce coord + embargo. Reconvene Fri 9am PT unless critical updates. :thumbsup:
